bio: In the chic little fine dining restaurant of Schwitzer's Hotel am Park, the open kitchen means you can watch chef-patron Cédric Schwitzer and team at work. Using excellent ingredients, they craft the four- or six-course set menu, giving classic recipes a modern twist. The end result is dishes that are sophisticated, without being convoluted or overbaked. The elegant and beautifully balanced Bresse guinea fowl breast, for example, leaves a lasting impression – wonderfully succulent with bold roasted notes, it is paired with a deliciously tart kohlrabi rose and an exquisite, perfectly seasoned velouté with glorious depth of flavour.
